run_benchmark: run the Deformable DETR inference speed benchmark and print FPS to stdout
run_benchmark_with_checkpoint: run the benchmark loading a pre-trained checkpoint via the --resume flag
run_benchmark_custom_batch: run the benchmark with a custom batch size using the --batch_size flag
measure_average_inference_time: measure the average inference time of a PyTorch model over multiple iterations
get_benckmark_arg_parser: get the argparse parser for configuring benchmark iterations, warmup, batch size, and checkpoint
